title: Repo hygiene: commit untracked source tree + consolidate duplicate test files
description: HIGHEST OPERATIONAL RISK: git tracks only .tasks/, docs/, AGENTS.md, task — the entire source tree (packages/, apps/, package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, pnpm-workspace.yaml, tsconfig.base.json, CLAUDE.md) is untracked. ~500 done tasks of work have zero version-control history; one bad 'git clean' loses everything. Add and commit the source tree in a small number of logical commits (workspace config, packages/swf, packages/core, packages/authoring-ui, apps/desktop, player). Do NOT commit junk: review stray root artifacts (prompt, prompt-manager, prompt-oracle, .playwright-mcp/) and gitignore or remove them. Then consolidate duplicate test files created by parallel agents — keep the superset of coverage, delete the dupe, run the package tests: packages/swf sound-stream.test.ts vs soundstream.test.ts; cxform.test.ts vs colortransform.test.ts; round-trip.test.ts vs roundtrip.test.ts; packages/core/src/fla/__tests__/ole.test.ts vs ole2.test.ts. From now on, agents should commit source changes when completing tasks, not just task JSON.
